continuum: mixed classes projected onto pure-parent axes (0..1=between)
interpretation: VTL gives a reproducible continuous structural position. Mixed classes sit between pure parents (continuum, not category). ~X% of samples are closer to another class centroid -> reproducibly-flagged label ambiguity, concentrated where the taxonomy is genuinely fuzzy (mixtures vs parents). This is the domain contribution: reproducible structural measurement where categorical expert labels are subjective.
